result: The archive was broken at the routing layer, not in the query. `routes/web.ts` registered a single pattern `'/posts/archive/:date*'`; a route param never spans a `/`, so `:date*` was read as a one-segment param literally named `date*` — `/posts/archive/2026` matched but left `date` unset (hence the 422 about a missing required value), and `/posts/archive/2026/08` matched nothing at all (404). I replaced it with two plain routes, `'/archive/:year/:month'` (`posts.archive.month`) and `'/archive/:year'` (`posts.archive`), both still registered before `'/:id'` and both pointing at `PostController.archive`. `ArchiveParamSchema` in `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts` became `ArchiveParamsSchema`, validating `year` as four digits and an optional `month` as `0?[1-9]|1[0-2]` — so `08` and `8` both pass while `13`/`00` are rejected with a 422 before any query runs — and `PostController.archive` now reads `{ year, month }` directly, keeping the existing `created_at` ISO-prefix `LIKE` match (compared as stored, UTC) and the `{ data: [...] }` newest-first response untouched. I re-ran `bun run codegen` so `.guren/routes.gen.ts` and `.guren/api-client.gen.ts` carry the new paths, and added `tests/PostArchive.test.ts` covering month, zero-less month, year, empty periods, and the out-of-range month/year rejections against fixtures pinned to 2018–2019 so the boot-time seeders can't skew the counts; `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (8 pass, 0 fail), and `bunx guren check` (0 failures) all pass.
